The House Committee on Health offers Bill 1295 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Cooper of the following substitute to HB 1295: 45th, Stephens of the 164th, Hawkins of the 27th, Au of the 50th, LaHood of the 175th, and others
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Article 4 of Chapter 34 of Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to physician assistants, so as to enter into an interstate compact known as … and the Participating States are binding in accordance with their terms."
SECTION 5. This Act shall become effective on July 1, 2027.
SECTION 6. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
